game.name: Seterra (Geoguessr Version)
game.rules:
## *General Rules*

## 

- Must get 100% score in order to improve the quality of submitted runs.  
- Leaderboard goes by in-game timer, please don't submit real time. 
- Final time is in milliseconds, please show one's time with milliseconds at the end of a run (done by having speedrun mode activated in settings under the map)
- You are not allowed to use any software to bind multiple keys to left click or right click to for example gain an advantage when bruteforcing.
- Lagging the game on purpose to get a better time is not allowed.
- In 100% runs, time starts after resetting the timer of the first map. 

### *Video Requirements*

- Full video is required for all runs.
- Recording the audio is highly recommended.
- All kinds of autoclickers and scripts are banned.
- If you are submitting multiple runs in one video, please provide timestamps.

### *Platforms*

- Website runs must show the cursor in the video.
- Touch Web runs must use touch screen in the video.
